_comment: MSN params fit to the measured hardware neuron (IFcurve.xlsx + spike_fit.bin).
_method: Ra, Cm fixed to hardware. Rm_lo=53 ohm from the high-res 40kHz spike capture (peak+width matched exactly, both channels agree). Rm_hi, Vth, I_hold fit to the working-range F-I curve (41-92uA, RMSE 6.8 Hz). Depol-block corner (>93uA) excluded as device-specific.
_note_device_variability: spike_fit.bin neurons have Vth~2.10V; this F-I device has Vth~2.50V. Both normal within the 1.1-2.8V device spread. Vth is per-device; Rm_lo (thyristor on-state) is ~tens of ohms across devices.
